## Your research, your terms

Whether you need a hand with one piece of the puzzle or a partner for the whole journey, I'll meet you where you are.

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.service-card}
### Study Design

Starting a new study or writing a proposal? This is the ideal time to get statistical input. Sample size calculations, randomisation strategies, and protocol stats sections.

[Learn more &rarr;](services.qmd)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.service-card .service-card-sage}
### Data Analysis

Already have data? I work with regression, survival analysis, mixed-effects models, complex survey designs, and more.

[Learn more &rarr;](services.qmd)
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.service-card .service-card-teal}

Need publication-ready tables, figures, or a results section your reviewers will accept? I can help with that too.

[Learn more &rarr;](services.qmd)
